text:
Maya: Heads-up — acme flagged a competitor launch: low-cost per-route routing + fallback. They're asking if we can match their offering. Need triage on scope vs speed.
Jordan: Oof. Do we have an eng effort ballpark?
Maya: Not yet. Sales wants an ETA for the renewal.
Priya: Acme is on the cusp. If we can show a narrow solution, they may sign.
Alex: Could we ship a minimal backend-only policy that selects model variants by tenant and cost? No UI initially.
Jordan: Roughly: 2 sprints backend + rollout/ops effort. But maybe smaller if we reuse the policy engine.
Ravi: Design can produce a single toggle mock and a small admin surface in 2 days for demos.
Sam: Watch parity traps — we shouldn't chase mimicry if it hurts our differentiators. Ask: will this be a paid premium tier or included?
Maya: We need crisp launch criteria, e.g. perf parity (p95 request decision <50ms), API stability, docs & billing flag.
Jordan: Also rollout safety: canary to 1% -> 10% -> 100% with auto-fallback to baseline.
ops-bot: Reminder: maintenance window 03:00 UTC available for risky deploys.
Priya: Sales needs an ETA by EOD. Can we do a spike today?
Alex: I can spike on routing reuse tomorrow morning. If we can plug into existing KV cache/policy hooks, effort drops to ~5 days.
Jordan: I'll join spike. If spike shows reuse, we do an MVP for Dedicated + Hosted Pro.
Maya: Decision rule: if spike <=5d and perf targets feasible, greenlight narrow MVP; otherwise deprioritize for Q4.
Priya: Could accept a Hosted beta limited to top-tier customers if that speeds rollout.
Sam: Messaging note: phrase it as "cost-aware routing controls" — avoids reactive positioning.
Ravi: I'll sketch a demo flow and two admin screens for the beta.
Jordan: Spike owners: @Jordan, @Alex. ETA 72h. I'll post findings here.
Jordan: Perf target for the spike: p95 gateway decision <120ms to avoid user impact.
Maya: Add to launch checklist: SLOs, docs, billing flag, rollout knobs, support runbook, migration notes, eval prompts.
Priya: I'll draft customer FAQ and negotiation anchors.
Alex: Quick config idea to test in spike:
```
policy:
  selector: tenant_id
  prefer: lowest_cost_compatible
  fallback: baseline_model
  ttl: 60s
```
Jordan: If that integrates, we avoid a lot of plumbing.
Maya: Good. Keep scope minimal: no cross-tenant UI, just API/flag control for now.
Sam: Also recommend adding a metric to track "percent routed to cheaper variant" and quality deltas.
Ravi: I'll wire a demo gif for sales to use in the interim.
Maya: OK — spike results posted here. If green, schedule cross-functional kickoff next Tues.
Jordan: Noted.
Alex: Will run spike and push a short doc with tradeoffs.
Maya: Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
